name: Jack
source: Admiring the ninja of Japan with the stated goal of becoming a full-fledged ninja in their homeland, flew out from Texas. Jack's various ninjas techniques are a result of Jack's own effort. Uses an alias because according to a ninja book Jack read long ago, ninjas never reveal their true names.
